name: @thirdchimp/skills-manager
description: Dynamic skill discovery, install, evaluate and cleanup from skills.sh for AI agent orchestrators
author: kaufd

scripts.build: bun build src/skills-manager.ts --outfile dist/skills-manager.js --target node && tail -n +2 dist/skills-manager.js > /tmp/sm_shebang && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - /tmp/sm_shebang > dist/skills-manager.js && chmod +x dist/skills-manager.js
